name: Classical
description: Cello, viola, violin and piano: the instruments fitted to real recordings (solo Bach by two concert soloists; the SWAM viola and cello of ROLI's Seaboard demos; a Steinway B and a Bösendorfer). The best sounds in the app. Max Richter is the piano after his recordings (felt-dark, close, with the strings ringing on), fitted to two of his albums.
